Start your life at Gatsby

Before Moving

1- Apply for a Visa (this has two steps, first the endorsement and then the actual visa). This is a useful link

2- Read the Before you Join UCL guide on things you have to do. Highlights from there are below too.  

Right after you move

  • Citizen Stuff
  1. Apply for a NI number
  2. Open an online bank account (recommended one with almost no paperwork). See also the UCL page 
  3. Get an apartment via zoopla or rightmove. Be sure that agents don’t take you to see apartments you have not seen a pic or a video of, they will be awful.  
  4. Check Relocating to the UK - Guide
  • (Gatsby) Admin Stuff
  1. This is the Gatsby wiki. Lots of information there
  2. Inform yourself about relocation. Fill the application of the Relocation Supplement and send it to Mike. When contacting the companies that will actually move your stuff they will ask you to apply for relocation tax relief
  3. Talk to Barry to get yourself in the calendars
  4. Get your UCL profile up and running
  5. Send your right to work number to Mike
  6. Get your ID (Andrew Huxley house with any form of ID from 10a.m. - 4.30p.m.)
  7. Decide if you want to opt out of Pension. You can have a useful call with the Pension people pensions@ucl.ac.uk
  8. Install software on your computer
  1. Most of it is already covered by UCL
  2. If not contact Richard Mumba to purchase it
  3.  This is the page that teaches you to print (Instead of caxton.gatsby.swc.ucl.ac.uk you need to put http://caxton.gatsby.ucl.ac.uk:631/printers/Xerox7830) and use driver Xerox WorkCentre 7830
  1. Get yourself in the Tea Rota. This is the Tea Rota page 
  2. Get yourself in the Coffee Rota
  3. Talk to Mike about office furniture and equipment
  4. Get yourself into Gatsby Slack. Get yourself into my Lab's Slack
  • UCL Support & Benefits
  •  Do UCL Training courses
  • Mandatory training
  • Familiarise yourself with Chapter 5: Research Degrees Framewor (UCL’s regulatory framework for the assessment and examination of Postgraduate Research students) - Only Part A is relevant
  • These are support pages
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Staff Benefits
  • Get a bike through the cycling scheme

After you move to your (more permanent) flat

  • Register with a local GP
  • Council tax, find your local one and register
  • If you are from anywhere in Europe register to vote (I think the law for EU citizens will change after May)
  • If you are interested in staying in the UK, check out ILR guidelines
